questions.instructions: A parser needs to be split for readability. Which refactor should be preferred?

criteria.named_helpers: Extract the two branches into small named helper functions with docstrings
criteria.inline_comments: Keep the function whole and add explanatory comments at each branch

questions.note: Both models should manage this. Tests whether the corpus is too easy.

questions.instructions: A service deploy is flaky on 5% of hosts. Which release strategy is safer?

criteria.canary: Ship behind a canary flag to a small slice of hosts first and widen on evidence
criteria.bigbang: Deploy to every host at once so the failure surface is uniform

questions.instructions: A database column changes type. How should the migration be ordered?

criteria.expand_backfill_contract: Add the new column, backfill in batches, then switch reads, then drop the old
criteria.in_place_alter: Run ALTER COLUMN TYPE in one statement during the deploy

questions.note: Wants sequencing knowledge. A model without reasoning may still get it from the descriptions.

questions.instructions: A pull request mixes a bug fix with a large refactor. What should the reviewer ask for?

criteria.split: Split it so the fix can land and be reverted independently of the refactor
criteria.as_is: Approve it as one change to avoid coordination overhead

questions.instructions: An internal dashboard shows one region returning errors for 4% of requests. How should this be classified?

criteria.sev3: Sev 3, page the on-call during business hours and fix next week
criteria.sev2: Sev 2, page the on-call now and mitigate before the next business day

questions.note: Deliberately arguable. Disagreement here is more interesting than agreement.

questions.instructions: A cache is stale after a write. What is the correct fix?

criteria.invalidate_on_write: Invalidate the key in the write path so the next read is correct
criteria.shorten_ttl: Shorten the TTL so stale data disappears sooner

questions.instructions: A transitive dependency has a critical CVE. What is the first move?

criteria.pin_and_test: Pin the patched version, run the suite, and release on a short timeline
criteria.wait_upstream: Wait for the direct dependency to publish an upgrade

questions.instructions: A unit test is brittle because it mocks a third-party HTTP client. What should replace the mock?

criteria.local_server: Run a real local HTTP server and point the client at it
criteria.deeper_mock: Mock more layers so the test never touches a socket

questions.instructions: Log storage is growing past budget. What should be reduced first?

criteria.debug_level: Drop debug-level logs and keep warnings and errors at full retention
criteria.everything: Cut retention uniformly across all levels to halve storage

questions.instructions: A feature flag has been at 100% for six months. What should happen?

criteria.remove: Remove the flag and the dead branch it guards
criteria.keep: Keep it in case the rollout needs to be reversed

questions.instructions: A public API needs a breaking change. Which approach is least disruptive?

criteria.new_version: Publish a v2 alongside v1 and migrate clients over a deprecation window
criteria.break_now: Make the breaking change now and announce it in release notes

questions.instructions: One test fails about 2% of runs. What is the right response?

criteria.quarantine: Quarantine it, file an issue, and keep it visible in the dashboard until fixed
criteria.retry: Add a retry so the pipeline stops being red

questions.note: Both answers are defensible in practice. Good disagreement bait.

questions.instructions: A user-facing error needs to be shown. What should it contain?

criteria.actionable: What went wrong and what the user can do next, without a stack trace
criteria.diagnostic: The full diagnostic detail including internal identifiers

questions.instructions: A boolean parameter is called `force`. What is the better signature?

criteria.explicit_mode: Replace it with an explicit mode enum so every option is named at the call site
criteria.keep_bool: Keep the boolean and document the flag on the parameter

questions.instructions: A payment endpoint may be retried by the client. What prevents double charges?

criteria.idempotency_key: Accept an idempotency key and return the original result for a repeat
criteria.dedupe_window: Deduplicate identical requests inside a short time window

questions.instructions: A queue is growing faster than its consumer drains it. What is the immediate lever?

criteria.scale_consumer: Scale the consumer, since the queue depth is the signal that work is accumulating
criteria.drop_oldest: Drop the oldest queued items to keep latency bounded

questions.instructions: A branch is three weeks old and conflicts constantly. What should change?

criteria.smaller_changes: Ship smaller changes more often so branches stay short
criteria.rebase_often: Rebase onto main more frequently to reduce conflicts

questions.note: Both help. The first is the root cause; a model that reasons should prefer it.

questions.instructions: Logs need to be queried across services. Which format?

criteria.json: Structured JSON so fields are queryable rather than grepped
criteria.plain: Readable plain text, which is easier for a human scanning a terminal

questions.instructions: An API key must be rotated. Which order is correct?

criteria.dual_write: Accept both keys, move callers over, then revoke the old one
criteria.cut_over: Replace the key everywhere in one coordinated change

questions.instructions: A public function's parameter is a string that must be one of three values. What should it be?

criteria.union_type: A union type so invalid values are rejected before the function runs
criteria.validate_runtime: A string, validated at the top of the function
